caseName: Shahin v. E. I. du Pont de Nemours & Co.
caseNameFull: Shahin v. E. I. du Pont de Nemours & Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and certiorari dismissed. See this Court’s Rule 39.8.

Justice Alito took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
